about_the_game:
In Farm BoYS (Bottom of Your Screen), you embark on a cozy idle farming adventure. While you watch your farm grow and prosper, your workers take care of the tasks. Every action, from planting vegetables to raising animals, brings your farm closer to success.

Farming Made Simple

Start with a small plot of land and transform it into a reliable source of income. Plant seeds, water your crops and harvest them when they're ready. Selling vegetables will earn you the gold needed to expand and upgrade your farm.

  • Plant, water and harvest vegetables

  • Upgrade your workers to improve efficiency.

  • Turn simple crops into a steady profit.

Fishing With Surprises

Once you have got the hang of the fields, head to the river for a change of pace. Fishing is a great way to earn extra income and uncover surprises that could transform your gameplay.

Life on the Farm

Your farm is more than just crops. Build barns and raise animals to diversify your production. Sheep, goats and cows provide valuable products, while chicken coops and duck houses keep things lively. Each building can be upgraded to make your farm more efficient.

Here's what you can raise:

  • Sheep, goats and cows in barns

  • Chickens and ducks in coops

Animals that provide new products to sell.

The Marketplace

The local marketplace keeps your farm connected to the outside world. Completing special orders brings in more gold, as well as rare items that can give you unique advantages. It’s up to you whether to focus on crops, animals or fishing in order to meet demand.

A Relaxing Idle Adventure

Farm BoYS combines the charm of farming with the satisfying loop of idle gameplay. Whether you’re actively managing your workers or letting them run the farm while you take a break, your farm will continue to progress.

Sit back, relax, and watch your farm grow. One harvest, one catch and one upgrade at a time.

Why You’ll Love It

  • A cozy farming world that grows even while you’re away

  • Easy-to-learn gameplay with rewarding upgrades

  • Surprising fishing moments that keep things fresh

  • A variety of animals to raise and products to sell

  • Marketplace orders that add strategy and progression

  • The perfect mix of relaxing idle play and satisfying farm building

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or Intel Iris Plus Graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: In Farm BoYS, you can enjoy the cosy experience of an idle farming game. Plant crops, catch fish and raise animals to grow your farm. Upgrade your workers and buildings, fulfil marketplace orders and uncover surprises as your farm flourishes, even when you’re away.
